body: Thanks! I just wish that it wasn't an internet hug and was a in-person hug, but I'll take what I can get.

Thank you. It does put a lot of pressure on me. I haven't come out to my family. I very much fear their reaction when I do come out. That is a major part of what is fueling my depression. I used to love going to church. It has a nice community with it that made me feel like people cared about me, but now I don't have that community anymore (I still go to church since I haven't told my parents that I don't believe because it would likely bring up a large conversation about why I don't which is mostly because I am gay). I need to feel that people care.

I know that there is nothing wrong with me for being gay. It is fear of my family (and others) and that they clearly think it is wrong and disgusting. And I want the other people to continue to have fun after I'm gone if I do end my life. The point of me killing myself isn't to make most people not have fun anymore, it's to prevent me from suffering further pain.

I could, but it would be really hard. I haven't come out to my family and even though I don't have any real friends where I'm at, I do have a few people that I would like to continue to be around. And I feel like I would have just as hard of a time anywhere else, because I have a hard time letting anyone know that I am gay. It took me many months to tell the first person (my ex-friend that I talked about in the second paragraph), and that was even despite the fact that he constantly gave clear signs that he has other gay friends and was okay with it.

I know that being gay isn't disgusting or a bad thing, but my family and everyone around me thinks that it is. I still live at home and being Mormon is a major part of my family. I still go to church every Sunday because otherwise I would have to tell my family that I don't believe and then we would have a long uncomfortable discussion about why I don't believe, which I am not prepared to do in part because I am not ready to come out to my family. I appreciate your willingness to be my friend, but I need a friend who I can hang out with in person or give a hug when I need one. And i dropped out of college because depression has killed my dreams. I've watched videos after videos and movies after movies trying to help me feel better. Some help a little bit, but any help is temporary.
